entities.name: 8-amino-7-oxononanoate synthase (sequence query)
observations: 390 aa; estimated mass 42.60 kDa; theoretical pI 5.54.
Exact full-sequence match to reviewed UniProt B1YMC6 from Exiguobacterium artemiae.
Catalyzes pimeloyl-ACP + L-alanine to 8-amino-7-oxononanoate (AON) + holo-ACP + CO2; EC 2.3.1.47, Rhea RHEA:42288.
PLP-dependent enzyme associated with biotin biosynthesis; reviewed homolog is a homodimer.
Pfam profile Aminotran_1_2 spans residues 39–380; related aminotransferase-family profiles also detected.
